title: Endurance: Shackleton's Incredible Voyage
author: Alfred Lansing
summary: Alfred Lansing recounts Ernest Shackleton's 1914 Antarctic expedition, when the ship Endurance was crushed by ice. The crew survived for months on the ice, then at sea, before a desperate rescue.
readIf: you want a gripping true survival story told in plain, vivid detail.
skipIf: you dislike cold, hardship and stories involving the killing of animals.
